llms.txt - 5933judgerobotics.com (JudgeMent Call Robotics, FRC Team 5933)

Site Overview
JudgeMent Call Robotics (FRC Team 5933) is a student-run FIRST Robotics Competition team from Judge Memorial Catholic High School (JMCHS) in Salt Lake City, UT. The team provides collaborative, competition-based STEM opportunities for high school students, welcoming those from nearby schools without FRC teams. Motto: "It's the hardest fun you will ever have."

Core Values: Coopertition, Gracious Professionalism  
Annual Budget Goal: $40,000 (funded entirely by donations/sponsorship)  
Contact: jmrobotics@jmchs.org | Instagram: @jmrobotics.5933 | X: @JMRobotics_5933 | Facebook: JudgeMentCall5933  
Onion Site: http://4a7eonia5fsfdajejtqiqxj6wp36pcgmbkn3tkphdjwhsazwqvxx7yid.onion  
Site Author: Wren Burchett (programmed by, no copyright/trackers, catppuccin colorscheme, philosophy of simplicity)



Key Pages

/index.html - Home
- Mission statement: collaborative STEM opportunity through FRC
- FRC background: founded 1994 by Dean Kamen & Woodie Flowers, 8-week build season, district/regional competitions
- Team philosophy: student-run with teacher/community/industry mentorship; students ultimately responsible

/donate.html - Donate
- Why donate: $40,000/year needed; breakdown: $6,400 airfare, $5,000/competition entry, $3,000 lodging, $600 transport, $340 food, $24,000+ parts/equipment
- Donation Tiers:
  - Bronze (<$500): sponsors page listing, team video mention, competition invite
  - Silver ($500–$999): + small logo on sponsor banner & team shirt
  - Gold ($1,000–$4,999): + medium logo on banner & shirt
  - Platinum ($5,000–$9,999): + logo on competition robot, large logo on banner/shirt, VIP competition invite
  - Diamond ($10,000+): + name/brand announced at competition, major presence in team video
- Donate online: https://squareup.com/store/judge-memorial-catholic-high-school  
- Mail: JudgeMent Call Robotics, Salt Lake City, UT 84102

- Email: jmrobotics@jmchs.org
- Social: Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook
- Onion site link

/sponsors.html - Sponsors
- Sponsor recognition page

/events.html - Events
- Event photo gallery (image/event.jpg)

- Team photo gallery (banner uses image/team5933.jpg)

/resources.html - Team Resources
- Resource library for team members and community
- Items: Team Google Drive, Team Tenets, Field Trip Release Form, and Team Calendar
- Each resource card shows type badge, description, and action buttons (view/download)

/make-coffee - Coffee Making Interface
- Brewing control endpoint for the team's coffee system
- Returns brewing status and pot readiness



Site Structure
- Static HTML/CSS site (hand-coded)
- Assets: /image/ (team photos, event photos, botwork), /icons/, /fonts/, /error/ (custom error pages)
- No JavaScript framework, no trackers, no copyright claims
- robots.txt blocks: /.git/, /fonts/, /icons/, /image/



LLM-Relevant Notes
- Privacy-first: No analytics, no cookies, no copyright — explicitly stated in footer on every page
- Tor accessible: Onion service available
- Student-authored: Built by a high school senior (Wren Burchett) with cybersecurity background
- Simple by design: Minimal dependencies, hand-written HTML/CSS
